About us

A general store built around the daily errand

DayBreak sits on the Eastern By-Pass, right next to Custom's Office — a stop people make on the way to somewhere else, and leave with everything they came in for.

Why the shelves stay simple

The store isn't trying to be everything. It's built around the small list of things a household actually runs out of — rice, oil, seasoning, airtime, a bar of soap — kept in one place instead of spread across a long aisle.

That's also why mobile money and airtime top-ups sit right alongside the groceries: most visits are quick, and DayBreak is set up so one stop covers more than one errand.

Local shoppers have rated the store 4.3 out of 5, with reviews calling it "fantastic" and describing it as a dependable regular stop on their route.
